acceptanceCriteria.ac: When a device is selected, firehose URLs are constructed from chipsetFolder
programmer.melf, digest.elf, signature.bin are automatically fetched
Loading progress is shown in the UI with clear status
Errors are logged to terminal and shown in toast notification
If auto-load fails, a popup offers manual file selection
Loaded firehose is cached in memory for the session
deviceStore.firehoseLoaded is set to true when complete
Progress indicator is shown during fetch with percentage/status

constraints.constraint: NEVER modify files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/ - only wrap with hooks
Use singleton pattern (useRef) for protocol instances in hooks
Sync state with Zustand stores (deviceStore, terminalStore)
Use shadcn/ui components for UI elements
Follow component pattern: hooks at top, derived state, handlers, render
Use useTranslation for all user-facing text

tests.standards: Testing currently uses manual verification via npm run dev. Future: Vitest + React Testing Library. Ensure all TypeScript compiles without errors. Test UI states visually in browser.

ideas.idea: Select device → verify console logs show correct URLs constructed from chipsetFolder
Select device → verify Network tab shows 3 fetch requests for programmer, digest, signature
Select device → verify FirehoseLoadingIndicator appears with loading state
Force 404 by selecting device with invalid URL → verify terminal shows error, toast appears
Force failure → verify ManualFirehosePopup appears with file inputs
Select device A → switch to B → switch back to A → verify no re-fetch (check Network tab)
Select device → verify deviceStore.firehoseLoaded is true via React DevTools
Select device → observe loading indicator shows file names being downloaded

urlConstruction.note:
devices.json now contains full GitHub raw URLs in firehose object: - programmerUrl: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../programmer.melf" - digestUrl: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../digest.elf" - signatureUrl: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../signature.bin"
Implementation should use these URLs directly from device.firehose object, NOT construct URLs manually from chipsetFolder.

cachingStrategy.note: Cache firehose files by chipset (not device ID) because multiple devices share same chipset. Use module-level Map outside component to persist across re-renders.
